reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing shared getScheduleAmount, but keeps the inline 0.075 tolerance instead of using the existing getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.

duplication.why: Adds no new copies; the pre-existing tolerance duplication with getApproxNumberThreshold is left in place.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts getScheduleAmount, which the server, forecast, API model and preview paths call.

scope.why: A two-line rule change plus updated tests.

maintainability.why: Math.min states the rule directly; the tree still carries other amount helpers (getScheduledAmount midpoint, schedule-template midpoint) that a maintainer must know are separate.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The change is made in the shared getScheduleAmount; the untouched inline tolerance predates the diff.
